claims: Paul George was suspended for 25 games without pay by the NBA on January 31, 2026.
Paul George was suspended for violating the terms of the NBA/NBPA Anti-Drug Program.
Paul George stated he took "improper medication" while seeking treatment for a mental health issue.
Paul George's taking of "improper medication" resulted in a failed drug test.
Paul George did not disclose the specific substance involved.
Paul George returned to the Philadelphia 76ers lineup on March 25, 2026, against the Chicago Bulls.
Paul George missed 25 games due to the suspension.
The suspension cost Paul George approximately $11.7 million in salary.
Paul George apologized to the 76ers organization, teammates, and fans.
Paul George noted the time away helped him heal nagging injuries and get into a better mental space for the playoffs.
The Philadelphia 76ers went 13-12 during Paul George's absence.
The Philadelphia 76ers saved over $5 million in luxury tax payments, according to Bobby Marks.
